full_prompt_en: A square, rough neo-expressionist painting shows a crowned fragmented face assembled from painted slabs against a pale gray wall. The background is scraped off-white with faint charcoal lines and small stains, leaving broad empty margins around the central construction. At the upper left, black spike-like strokes project upward from a dark green block. A jagged mustard-yellow crown sits across the upper center-right, its black dots and uneven points painted with little attempt at symmetry. Beneath it, a tall off-white face section holds one large circular dark eye. An even larger white-ringed eye protrudes on the left from a deep green side plane, making the two eyes conspicuously different in size and placement. Rust orange, burgundy, pink, and gray plates interrupt the cheeks and nose, some extending beyond any ordinary facial contour. Small round discs and short vertical bars look attached to the main head like bits of painted machinery. The mouth lies low near the center as a narrow white row of rough teeth inside a dark opening, while a blunt vertical pale shape crosses part of the face above it. Along the bottom, black rectangular blocks form a heavy base that cuts off the lower head. The paint is thick, scraped, and uneven, with visible brush drag, drips, and raw edges where one color collides with another. Light appears flat and frontal; the sense of depth comes chiefly from overlap, not realistic shading. The overall composition is playful and uneasy, using a near-central cluster of mismatched eyes, hard blocks, and coarse bright color against spacious dirty white.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、粗粝的新表现主义绘画呈现一张戴王冠的破碎面孔，由一块块涂过颜料的板状形体在浅灰色墙面前拼成。背景是被刮擦的灰白色，带淡炭色线条和小污痕，在中央结构周围留有宽阔空边。左上方，黑色刺状笔触从深绿色块向上伸出。一顶锯齿状芥末黄王冠横在上部中央偏右，黑点和高低不齐的尖角几乎不求对称。它下方，一条高高的灰白色脸部区域容纳一只大圆形深眼。左侧一只更大的白圈眼睛从深绿色侧面突出来，使两只眼在大小和位置上明显不同。铁锈橙、酒红、粉红和灰色板块打断面颊与鼻子，有些伸出普通脸形之外。小圆盘和短竖条看起来像涂过色的机器零件，附在主头部上。嘴巴低低位于中央附近，是深色开口中的一排狭窄粗白牙齿，上方还有一道钝直的浅色形状切过部分面孔。沿底部，黑色矩形块形成厚重底座，截断头部下方。颜料厚、被刮擦且不均匀，能看到拖笔、滴痕和颜色碰撞处的生硬边缘。光感平坦而偏正面；纵深主要来自遮挡，而非写实阴影。整体构图活泼又令人不安，以近乎居中的大小不一眼睛、坚硬色块和粗糙亮色，对照宽裕的脏白底面。
style_prompt_en: The painting assembles forms from blunt blocks, mismatched circular elements, and rough linear strokes. Thick opaque pigment is scraped, dragged, and allowed to drip, leaving raw seams and stained off-white ground visible. Mustard yellow, dirty cream, dark green, rust, burgundy, pink, and black meet in abrupt patches rather than smooth modeling. Proportions are deliberately uneven; one large accent can outweigh several smaller details and make the center feel unstable. Hard contours coexist with smudged or broken edges, and shallow overlap supplies most of the depth. Light is broadly frontal and quiet, so texture, color collision, and scale variation carry the expression. The overall effect is witty and unsettling, with coarse material energy held inside a compact graphic arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画以钝重色块、大小不一的圆形元素和粗糙线条组装形体。厚实不透明颜料被刮、被拖，并容许滴落，使生硬接缝和带污迹的灰白底面露出来。芥末黄、脏奶油色、深绿、铁锈色、酒红、粉红与黑色以骤然相接的色斑出现，而非平滑塑形。比例有意不均，一处大重音能压过几个小细节，使中心显得不稳定。坚硬轮廓与涂抹、断裂的边缘并存，浅层遮挡提供大部分纵深。光宽泛而偏正面，安静退后，让肌理、色彩碰撞和尺度变化承担表现力。整体效果机智而令人不安，粗砺的材料能量被收在紧凑的图形排列之中。
theme_en: A crowned, fragmented face assembled from rough painted shapes
theme_zh: 一张戴黄色王冠、由粗糙色块拼成的破碎面孔
name: George Condo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
